profile.headline: Software Developer at RealPage, Inc.
profile.summary:
Highly motivated IT professional offers extensive background in developing innovative computer applications. Project management qualifications with demonstrated ability to develop and implement technical solutions to meet business needs. I am proficient in database design and management as well as outstanding networking skills.

SUMMARY OF QUALIFICATIONS
* Application Development	
* Web Development	
* Internet/Intranet Design
* Database Design/Management	
* LAN/WAN Technologies
* Management Skills

Specialties: ASP.net, C#, VB, TSQL, Visual Studio, MSSQL (2005, 2008), VB script, Javascript, JQuery, CSS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Contributes specialized business and technical knowledge in multiple application development efforts. Principle responsibility is to provide leadership and technical expertise in development and support for RealPage’s Level One contact center applications. Utilizes industry experience to design and execute RealPage applications, working closely with clients, developers, and business analysts to improve the overall usability and functionality of the Level One product. Technical skills used: C#, ASP.net, .net Core, React, javascript, Tsql

Accomplishments
* Complete redesign of core leasing product (PAMM)
* New Product Sr. PAMM for Senior Properties
* Complete redesign of VisitCalendar – Allows agents to set visits for prospects.
* New Product Email Templates – Allows clients to customize email response.
* MongoDB Certificated
* Built Applications in React.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · C# · .NET Core · TSql · API

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Work with the creative team as a central player in the design, programming and implementation of a wide variety of applications (web, intranet, internet, Great Plains customizations and database design and programming). Created and modified Stored Procedures, Views, Triggers and User Defined Functions. Wrote advanced queries using T-SQL. Reviewed and recommended best practice solutions for the internet ecommerce site taking into consideration a “wish list”. Documented all programming processes and user functionality. Technical skills used: C#, asp.net (visual studio 2008/2005), XHTML, CSS, JavaScript, MS Sql server 2005, T-SQL.

Accomplishments
* Job Request System
* Sample Request System
* Item Request System
* Quality Improvement System
* Customizations to Great Plains
* Redesigned the Internet ecommerce website

positions.title: EBS Engineer
positions.description:
Aid in the development of new features and application enhancements using C#, asp.net, MS Sql Server. Collaborate with other engineers on the team and work with members of Product Management and Quality Assurance teams to ensure the delivery of high quality application features that will provide the maximum benefit clients. Participate in release and development iteration planning sessions by creating technical designs, estimating features, providing feedback on previous releases and iterations, and recommending changes and ways to improve in future iterations and releases.

Accomplishments
	* Quoting Application
	* MS CRM Integration with Quoting Application
	* Work Request Application
	* JIRA Integration with Work Request Application (Web Service)

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Design and develop applications for in-house use. Developed Online CRM tool, Service Tickets Application and Timesheet Application. Created reports using Sql Server Reporting Services. Tools used C#, asp.net,vb.net, javascript, Visual Studio 2005, Sql Server 2005. Used MS Office 2007. To increase efficiency, I replaced antiquated systems to new effective online applications. Mentored and tutored JR developers.

Accomplishments
* Customized CRM Application
* Service Ticket Application
* Timesheet Application 
* Customer Signup Application
* Omnis Change Requests Application
* EmailBlaster - Mass emailing Application

positions.title: Developer of Service Tools
positions.description:
Design and develop applications for the service department. Perform data analysis/development using various tools such as Oracle, SQL Server, PL/SQL, Crystal Reports, Excel and MS Access. Participate in the full life cycle of technical solutions, including analysis, design, development, testing, implementation and deployment. Optimize queries and create reports using SQL and related tools. Java, Netbeans, JPA, EJB, JavaServer Faces, JavaServer Pages, Visual Studio 2005(C#), SQL Server 2005/2000 and Oracle 10g are some of the tools used in developing application.  

Accomplishments
* Web LDAP Administration tool
* Preventive Maintenance Schedule Application
* Timesheet Application for Customer Support Engineers in the field
* Attended SUN Tech Days, Atlanta, a Worldwide Developer Conference
* Attended Netbeans Day, Atlanta
* Attended JavaServer Faces, Ajax class in Atlanta

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Create customized applications that interact with Microsoft Great Plains using Visual Studio 2003, C#, VB.net, Dexterity, SQL Server 2000. Write product specifications and user manuals. Define and implement programming standards and software objectives. Build reports using SQL Server Reporting Services.

Accomplishments
* Attended SQL Server 2005: New Features for Developers - 2005
* Attended SharePoint Portal Server 2003 Site Development and Customization Workshop - 2005
* Developed Trip Scheduling, Add-On Pricing and Customer Service modules to Microsoft Dynamics

positions.title: Sr. Developer
positions.description:
Designed and Developed web applications using C#, ASP.net, ADO.net, Visual Studio.net, Adobe Photoshop, ASP, HTML and JavaScript. Create and manage online surveys for physicians and consumers for market research services. Create tools with Visual Basic 6.0 and Perl to accelerate data analysis of research services. Developed programming standards and guidelines for coding to be used by DoctorDirectory.com, Inc. Planned development schedules and delegated work assignments to a team of up to 3 developers and designers. Ported existing web applications from SQL Server 7.0, Java, ASP code to the .net framework, specifically, C#, ASP.net, ADO.net (Visual Studio.net), SQL Server 2000, Data Transformation Services (DTS). 

Accomplishments
* Created online Inventory request system
* Designed physician enrollment application
* Administer MS Exchange 2000 Server
* Administer MS SQL Server 2000
* Designed and maintain LAN/WAN
* FastTrack - Designed and developed real time tracking system
